maps.name: Drop-Off
maps.description: An industrial rooftop arena with control rooms, elevated platforms and working ziplines.
maps.notes: Preview for Skirmish, Pilots vs Pilots and Free For All. Restores 366 source placements: utility conduits, tanks, crates, furniture and structural details. Uses 97.06% of native world index capacity with no added dynamic entities. Preserves the Apex minimap, Northstar banners, displays, paint, lighting, room closures, safety volumes and ziplines. Some props, animated materials and source runtime colouring remain incomplete. Intro and evac are disabled.

maps.name: Phase Runner
maps.description: Snow, rock and industrial tunnels connect opposing bases beneath the phase machinery.
maps.notes: The control-room consoles in both bases are drawn from the full Apex mesh with lighting taken from their own surface, so their panels no longer look stretched or streaky. Includes 1.7.1: flicker-free base floors, container frames, smooth catwalks, and 1.7.0 blending, ground tiling and rock collision.

maps.name: Overflow
maps.description: An industrial arena with elevated lanes, molten channels and opposing bases.
maps.notes: Fixes z-fighting and flat textures from Apex overlays that were drawn as solid surfaces on top of the surface below: stencil lettering (REFINERY, the capsules) and arrow signs are now proper decals, the flat brown dirt sheet over the asphalt is removed, and the lava no longer flickers between its glow and a grey duplicate. The invisible barrier in the ceiling opening is an Apex player clip and is kept. Known issue (also in 0.4.0): about one load in five can crash Northstar at spawn; restart and load again.

maps.name: Party Crasher
maps.description: City streets, multilevel buildings and the crashed Voyage form a compact pilot arena.
maps.notes: Adds a new Northstar billboard image to the curved Oasis screen, matching the Drop-Off banner artwork. Geometry, collision, lighting and gameplay are unchanged from 0.6.3.

maps.name: Firing Range
maps.description: The original training landscape adapted as a Titanfall pilot sandbox.
maps.notes: Rocks now collide with the shape you see: 329 rocks drawn at coarse detail had full-detail Apex collision, which left invisible rock to bump into and visible rock to fall into. Their collision is now the drawn shape, and spawns that stood on the old shape were moved onto the visible ground. Invisible player clips left around the missing shooting-range targets are removed. Invisible collision across the playable area drops from about 16% to under 3% of collision surface. Includes 0.5.0 blending and rock detail. Weapon stations, targets, foliage and AI navigation remain absent. Restart between previews.

maps.name: Thermal Station
maps.description: World's Edge's geothermal station and its lava fields, cut out of the battle royale map as a pilot arena.
maps.notes: Converted from current Apex. The arena is cut from the full World's Edge map with its own collision, lighting and storm sky. Bright overlays and z-fighting dirt were retired after the first playtest. There is no R5Reloaded source for this version of the map, so the gallery shows the port only.

maps.name: Thunderdome
maps.description: Fuse's floating arena: wetlands, treehouses and the giant skull, ringed by a stadium crowd.
maps.notes: Converted from current Apex. Over 6,700 Apex props are compiled as native static props with collision, faded foliage and re-baked shadows. The map is split into visibility cells so blocked areas are not drawn, and small clutter fades with distance. Apex's runtime UI screens around the stadium cannot be reproduced and show their static backing. There is no R5Reloaded source for this map, so the gallery shows the port only.
